sources.label: Morphe patches for DeepSeek: PairIP bypass, package rename, microG-RE support
sources.author: bicybert
patch_list: Builds microG DeepSeek, a separate app that signs in to your Google account through microG-RE (MicroG-RE or ReVanced GmsCore). Not for root installs.
Installs alongside stock DeepSeek under its own package name. On by default: a re-signed copy cannot replace the stock app.
Neuters PairIP's license check, which contacts Google Play on every start and shuts the app down when it was not installed by Play. Needed for a re-signed copy to run at all.
